Class Bible

java.lang.Object
entity.Entity
entity.weapon.Weapon
entity.weapon.Bible
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObject, Renderable, Updatable, AmountIncreasable, CooldownDecreasable, DamageIncreasable, DurationIncreasable, SizeIncreasable, SpeedIncreasable
public class Bible extends Weapon implements DamageIncreasable, SizeIncreasable, AmountIncreasable, SpeedIncreasable, DurationIncreasable, CooldownDecreasable
Bible — an orbital weapon inspired by Vampire Survivors' rotating-bible mechanic.

When the cooldown elapses, a wave of amount glowing books is spawned and rotated around the player at a fixed radius. Any enemy within the collision radius of a book takes damage every hitInterval seconds. The wave expires after duration seconds.

Implementation pattern

The equipped Bible instance sits in a weapon slot and drives its own cooldown via use(double). When the cooldown fires it adds this to GameManager.getUsingWeaponList(). The game loop then calls update(double) and render(GraphicsContext) on the same instance until isExpired() returns true.

Upgrade scaling

  • Every level: damage ×1.15, angular speed ×1.05, duration ×1.05, cooldown ×0.95
  • Levels 3, 5, 7: +1 book

      Description copied from class: Weapon

      Implementations should increment Weapon.timeSinceUse by accumulateDeltaTime and fire (spawning a projectile in GameManager.getUsingWeaponList()) when the cooldown elapses.

    • update

      public void update(double accumulateDeltaTime)
      Description copied from class: Weapon
      Advances the state of an active projectile / effect that was already spawned.

      After Weapon.use(double) creates and adds a weapon instance to usingWeaponList, the game loop calls update() on it every frame until Weapon.isExpired() returns true.
